picks.editorial_note: A $100M national program to build regional AI compute infrastructure is a major federal investment that will broaden access to AI-enabled research beyond elite institutions and seed a technical workforce pipeline.
picks.title: New NSF State and Regional AI Infrastructure Hubs will power AI-enabled scientific research across the country

picks.editorial_note: NIST's formal MOU with the DOE under the White House-led Genesis Mission signals a coordinated federal policy push to embed AI across national science and technology priorities.
picks.title: NIST Joins National Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI Innovation

picks.editorial_note: RPI leading two DOE Genesis Mission Phase I projects, including work with a national laboratory on rare-earth materials discovery, shows university-national lab AI collaboration at the core of a flagship federal initiative.
picks.title: RPI Selected for Two U.S. Department of Energy Genesis Mission Projects

picks.editorial_note: UC Davis researchers were selected among just 278 awardees from over 5,000 applications for the DOE's inaugural Genesis Mission awards, underscoring the intense competition and scale of this new national AI-for-science program.
picks.title: UC Davis Researchers Selected for Landmark DOE Genesis Mission Awards

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's deployment of the first AI-driven telescope demonstrates a concrete, working application of autonomous AI systems in scientific instrumentation, a milestone for the Genesis Mission's discovery goals.
picks.title: First AI-driven telescope goes stargazing

picks.editorial_note: A new $21.5M NSF AI Institute spanning four universities aims to advance human-AI collaboration in rehabilitation and health care, a substantial multi-institutional investment in applied AI research.
picks.title: UF researchers join new NSF-funded AI institute to transform rehabilitation and health care

picks.editorial_note: A $20M NSF grant to build an AI-enabled, cloud-based semiconductor lab at Virginia Tech extends the federal push toward automated, networked research infrastructure supporting the Genesis Mission.
picks.title: University receives $20 million grant for cloud-based semiconductor lab
picks.university: Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University

picks.editorial_note: NSF's $50M investment in two new Materials Innovation Platforms adds significant capacity for autonomous, AI-driven materials research at a national scale.
picks.title: NSF stands up 2 Materials Innovation Platforms with $50M investment

picks.editorial_note: HKU's atomically thin analogue in-memory search chip represents a genuine hardware breakthrough that could push AI computing efficiency past conventional architectural limits.
picks.title: HKU Engineering develops atomically thin “analogue in-memory search” chip to redefine AI computing limits with minimalist architecture - Press Releases - Media - HKU

picks.editorial_note: Lawrence Berkeley National Lab's AI modeling framework for predicting materials synthesis pathways is a notable scientific advance that could accelerate discovery of new advanced materials.
picks.title: New AI Modeling Approach Accelerates the Development of Advanced Materials
